in_marathi.name: Raahil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raahil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raahil is a name of Sanskrit origin meaning 'Traveler' or 'Journey'. It is a name that signifies the courage and determination of those who embark on a new path in life. Raahil is a name for those who are brave enough to explore new horizons, and who are determined to reach their goals no matter what obstacles may come in their way.
